verdict.rationale: Statsig documents the pieces of a guarded rollout: scheduled gradual rollouts on Feature Gates, metric measurement through experiments and scorecards, Infra Analytics alerts that catch regressions, and an emergency kill switch. Nothing in the evidence ties a metric regression to an automatic rollback, so you would have to wire alerts to the kill switch yourself through the Console API or CLI. Missing for 10: documented metric-guarded rollouts that halt or roll back automatically, a native link between regression alerts and gate rollback, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
